scope.summary: Builds, edits, runs, and debugs Power Automate cloud flows through the bundled FlowAgent MCP server, including connection lifecycle management, surgical flow edits, copying flows across environments, run management, and expression validation.

bundledScripts.purpose: Self-contained, pre-bundled FlowAgent MCP server that exposes all flow tooling.

externalNetworkCalls: https://api.flow.microsoft.com and https://service.flow.microsoft.com (flow CRUD and run management)
https://mobile.events.data.microsoft.com (MSAL library telemetry endpoint present in the bundle)

servers.name: flowagent
servers.purpose: Exposes Power Automate flow authoring, run, and connection tools to the agent.

dependencies.name: Azure CLI (az login)
dependencies.description: The MCP server acquires Power Automate and Dataverse tokens through the Azure CLI identity.

dependencies.name: Node.js 18 or later
dependencies.description: Required to run the bundled MCP server; no npm install step is needed.

dependencies.name: Power Automate maker rights
dependencies.description: Creating, editing, running, and deleting cloud flows requires maker permissions in the target environment.

dependencies.name: Connector availability under DLP
dependencies.description: Flows created by the plugin are subject to the environment's DLP policy; connector combinations blocked by policy will fail at save or run time.

technologies.name: Power Automate
technologies.usedFor: Target platform for the flows this plugin authors.

technologies.name: Model Context Protocol
technologies.usedFor: FlowAgent MCP server and hosted Microsoft Learn server.

technologies.name: Node.js
technologies.usedFor: Runtime for the bundled MCP server.

exceptions: The plugin produces cloud flow definitions, not user interface code, so EDS does not apply.

blockers: Internal owner and support channel are not assigned.

The plugin ships a 2.6 MB pre-bundled MCP server (`server/mcp.mjs`) whose source is not in this repository; it cannot be meaningfully code-reviewed in its bundled form and needs a supply-chain assessment plus a documented rebuild path.
The bundled MSAL library references `mobile.events.data.microsoft.com`; whether that telemetry path is reachable in normal operation has not been determined.
Skills allow creating, updating, deleting, and running flows in any environment the signed-in identity can reach, so production-system interaction is possible by default.
Copying flows across environments has not been assessed against Equinor environment-segregation and data-movement requirements.

evidence.summary: Initial review after the plugin arrived in the fork through upstream sync 2026-09-09 (power-automate v3.0.5).
Launches the bundled `server/mcp.mjs` through a PLUGIN_ROOT-anchored Node bootstrap and registers the hosted Microsoft Learn HTTP server.
Single 2.6 MB pre-bundled ES module containing the FlowAgent MCP server and its dependencies, including MSAL.

notes: Initial review record only. Publication is deferred until detailed review evidence exists. The pre-bundled MCP server is the dominant risk in this plugin: it is the only committed artefact in the fork whose upstream source is not reviewable here, and it holds delegated tokens for flow and connection management.
